name: Discogs Releases Subset (22k Releases)
description: A large subset of the Discogs music database describing over 22,000 music releases. The dataset includes structured metadata for each release such as title, artists, labels, release year, genres, styles, formats, and country of release. The data was derived from the Discogs public database dumps and transformed into a research-friendly structured format. Discogs content is crowdsourced and curated by its user community.

variableMeasured.name: id
variableMeasured.description: Internal dataset identifier for the release record (Discogs-derived).

variableMeasured.name: artist
variableMeasured.description: Primary credited artist for the release (single string as provided in the dataset).

variableMeasured.name: name
variableMeasured.description: Release title as provided in the dataset (may include multiple tracks or A/B sides separated by '/').

variableMeasured.name: country
variableMeasured.description: Country where the release was issued.

variableMeasured.name: genre
variableMeasured.description: High-level genre associated with the release (single value in this dataset).

variableMeasured.name: label
variableMeasured.description: Record label associated with the release (single value in this dataset).

variableMeasured.name: released
variableMeasured.description: Release date in a dataset-specific ISO-like format. Unknown month/day may be encoded as '00' (e.g., '1996-00-00' or '2000-06-00').

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track_name
variableMeasured.description: Ordered list of track titles for the release.

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track_rank
variableMeasured.description: Track position/rank corresponding to each entry in tracks_track_name.

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track_duration
variableMeasured.description: Track duration corresponding to each entry in tracks_track_name. May be null when unavailable.
